## Projects Catalog

### Echoes of Seasons
- **Status:** Done
- **Type:** Final-Year Game Project (Bellecour École)
- **Engine/Tech:** Unreal Engine 5, C++, Blueprints
- **Summary:** Puzzle adventure game where advancing through levels requires dynamically transitioning between seasons. Developed custom material functions and color math for seasonal transitions, engineered multithreaded C++ logic for high performance, and exposed gameplay parameters to designers via Blueprints.

### Pretty-Engine
- **Status:** Work in Progress
- **Type:** Custom Game Engine
- **Engine/Tech:** C/C++20, Vulkan API, Jolt Physics, OpenAL, CMake
- **Summary:** An open-source, multithreaded game engine for Linux and Windows. Features a Vulkan 3D rendering pipeline, Jolt Physics backend, OpenAL audio, custom reflection macros with leaf-header dependency management, and a thread-safe Dynamic Object System (DOS) for parallel system execution.

### Gluk Media Internship
- **Status:** Done
- **Type:** Professional Internship (Vilnius, Lithuania)
- **Engine/Tech:** Unity (UI Toolkit & UGUI), Rust (Rocket), Three.js, Hammer.js, Android
- **Summary:** Developed Android kiosk applications for museums and engineered a high-performance fullstack QR-code web experience utilizing Rust (Rocket) and Three.js 3D model rendering, optimized for sub-3-second load times over 3G networks.

### Bellum
- **Status:** Done
- **Type:** Mobile Game Project
- **Engine/Tech:** Unity, C#, Android
- **Summary:** Top-down 2D pixel-art action game for Android featuring close-combat mechanics and a virtual token-based inventory/shop system.

### Rust Tooling Ecosystem
- **Status:** Done & Active
- **Type:** Open-Source Tools & Libraries
- **Engine/Tech:** Rust, Tauri, Rocket
- **Summary:** Suite of tools including Flappy Editor (playable game inside VS Code), Fast-Assets (asset manager crate), Pretty-Ini (ini parser), Pro-CSV (CSV parser), Full-Logger (logging library & GUI server), and Tauri game dev launcher.

### Project-Survival
- **Status:** Work in Progress
- **Type:** Survival Strategy Game
- **Engine/Tech:** Unity 6, C#
- **Summary:** Top-down post-apocalyptic survival management game where zombie density escalates exponentially the longer players remain in an area, featuring branching narrative story cards and progressive resource scarcity.

### Pretty-Launcher
- **Status:** Work in Progress
- **Type:** Tooling & Plugin Backend
- **Engine/Tech:** Rust (pl-common), Lua, CLI
- **Summary:** Cross-platform extensible plugin backend and CLI client with Lua scripting for rapid and secure tool deployment.
